_comment: The one fixture both suites read (TQ-0054). internal/task writes every note
the CLI and the API append; frontend/notes.ts re-renders the same notes when
the board saves a body. The two normalise separately, so they can drift, and
the file is what a drift shows up in: whichever surface touched a task last
would decide its canonical form, and every save would land in a diff as
whitespace churn. Go asserts noteBullet against `bullet`, TypeScript asserts
formatNote against the same string, and both assemble the body around it.
Add a case here rather than to either suite.

cases.name: the blank lines around a note are dropped
a continuation line is indented under its bullet
nesting inside a note is kept
a run of blank lines collapses to one
trailing whitespace goes from every line
a uniformly indented paste loses the margin it was copied with
a shared margin goes and the indentation under it stays
a blank line does not defeat the shared margin
a shared margin of tabs goes too
an indent no other line shares is the note's own structure
a fenced block inside a note keeps its fences aligned
